# The house-style rules each page still breaks, one line per page and rule.
#
# TestTheDocsFollowTheHouseStyle (housestyle_test.go) holds every published
# page to docs/writing-docs.md's "Rules a test could check". A fault on a page
# and rule listed here is allowed for now. A fault that is not listed fails the
# test, and so does a line whose page now passes its rule.
#
# So this list only shrinks. When you fix a page, delete its lines. Never add
# one: a new fault is fixed in the page.
#
# Written on 24 November 2026 from the pages as they were then.
